15780.brief: a war room high in the guard tower, maps and a cold draught
15780.description: This chamber is a war room located high within the guard tower of IceCrag Castle. The walls are lined with large wooden racks that hold various scrolls and rolled-up parchment maps depicting the surrounding landscape and strategic points of interest. A long, sturdy table made from oak stands at the center of the room, covered in additional charts and notes scattered about, indicating recent planning sessions. The floor is cold underfoot, likely due to a constant draft blowing through gaps between stones near the ceiling, hinting at an unsealed section or narrow slit high above for ventilation or defense. Iron braziers placed along the walls emit a dim glow but do little to warm the chill air that fills the space.
